transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi. Yeah, um... honestly, the thing that scared me into coming in is that my eating has just been all over the place lately. Like, some days I just completely forget to eat any meals at all, and then... other nights, I'm tearing through takeout and snacks way past midnight. It's just really erratic right now, so I figured I should talk to somebody.
When you're eating a lot late at night, do you feel like you can't stop or control yourself once you start?

Um, no, not really. I don't feel like I can't stop. It's not like I'm out of control or anything. It's more just... I guess I finally realize I haven't eaten all day, and I'm just starving. So I eat a bunch of whatever is around. But if I get full, I can put it away. It's just a lot of food at a weird time, you know?
Have you noticed yourself eating much more rapidly than normal, or eating until you feel uncomfortably full during these late-night eating episodes?

No, not really. I don't think I'm eating any faster than I usually do. And I definitely don't eat until I'm sick to my stomach or uncomfortably full or anything like that. Like I was saying, once I feel full, I just stop. It's really just me finally getting some food in my system after missing meals all day.
Do you find yourself eating a lot of food even when you're not actually hungry, especially during these late-night eating times?

No, I wouldn't say that. When I eat late at night like that, it's really because I'm actually hungry. Like I said, it's usually after I've forgotten to eat all day, so by the time midnight rolls around, my stomach is just completely empty and I'm starving. I don't just eat for the sake of eating if I'm not hungry.
Do you ever feel embarrassed about how much you eat during these late-night episodes and find yourself eating alone because of it?

No, I don't feel embarrassed about it. I mean, I guess I am usually alone when I eat like that, but that's just because it's super late and, you know, everyone else is already asleep. I'm not hiding from anyone or trying to keep it a secret. It's really just me finally getting a meal in.
Do you ever find yourself eating late at night because you're feeling upset, stressed, or emotional?

No, it's not an emotional thing. I'm not eating because I'm upset or stressed out or anything like that. Like I said, it's really just that I realize I haven't eaten all day and I'm hungry. My body just needs the food.
Do you ever eat a very large amount of food in a short period of time during the day, even if it's not late at night?

No, not really. I mean, my eating habits are pretty normal during the day, assuming I actually remember to eat. I don't just sit down and binge a ton of food all at once. It's really just the late-night thing when I've skipped meals.
Do you typically wake up in the middle of the night and then eat, or are you already awake late at night and decide to eat because you're hungry?
I'm usually already awake. I don't really wake up just to eat. It's more like... I'm up late anyway, and then I realize how hungry I am because I haven't eaten, so I'll go get something.
Has this pattern of eating at night caused you any distress, or made it hard for you to function normally during the day?

Well, yeah, it's definitely causing some problems. I mean, I'm still showing up to work and everything, but it's getting harder. My manager actually started pulling me off some of my accounts recently because I've been making mistakes—things I normally wouldn't mess up. And, well, HR even got involved after an employee-assistance call I had to make. So, yeah, between that and just how things are at home, it really feels like everything is starting to slip out of my control.
